description: This line plot illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for five different Whisper fine-tuning configurations, all of type 'tiny'. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6 on a linear scale, while the y-axis represents WER, ranging from 30 to 70 on a linear scale. The plot displays five distinct lines: 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' (solid line with circle markers) starts at a WER of 69.5 at epoch 0 and decreases to 32.5 at epoch 6; 'tiny' (solid line with square markers) begins at 60.0 at epoch 0 and ends at 34.0 at epoch 6; 'tiny int4' (dashed line with circle markers) starts at 69.5 at epoch 0 and ends at 40.0 at epoch 6; 'tiny int8' (dashed line with square markers) begins at 60.0 at epoch 0 and ends at 36.0 at epoch 6; and 'tiny full' (dotted line with triangle markers) starts at 29.0 at epoch 0 and ends at 24.0 at epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend in WER over the epochs, with 'tiny full' showing the lowest WER throughout and 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' showing the steepest initial decline.
